reference: Anchored rescue; adaptive follow-up after chronology/receiver tree and directed boundary screens failed
hypothesis: A small smooth neural classifier can learn interactions between relative geometry, receiver evidence and phase semantics that axis-aligned trees do not recover. This is a representation change, not a threshold search.
data: Public eligible labels only; train-only median imputation with missing indicators, train-only standardization, team-swap augmentation, no early stopping or held-out calibration. Same frozen folds, buffers and padded label-free features. No private/video/annotation data.

screen.training: sklearn MLPClassifier hidden(64,32),relu,Adam,alpha1,max_iter150,batch128,learning_rate.001,early_stoppingFalse,tol0,n_iter_no_change151,random seed; class-balanced eligible augmented targets. screen.replace_current: Joint heads replace ordered current probabilities inside unchanged consensus+anchored rescue. Live-only head replaces conditional team probabilities of original current probabilities, keeping its D probability, then uses the same consensus+anchored inference.
screen.short_proposals: Use the same fixed proposal gates from RENEWAL_RESEARCH_PLAN (mean>=.65,8..125frames,contact or bracket support,opposite anchored flanks,no anchored D overlap); leave reference untouched elsewhere.

confirmation: Apply the substantial primary-gain and secondary gates in RENEWAL_RESEARCH_PLAN to unchanged finalists on all seeds/protocols. Record training convergence warnings and every failure.
